dedupe_keys.name: time series of flow measurement and water quality monitoring at a large combined sewer overflow in berlin

description: A Berlin water research group publishes three years of combined-sewer-overflow monitoring as a CSV. Zenodo provides the table free under CC BY 4.0, divided into twenty-two recorded overflow events. Columns include event and timestamp, flow velocity, cubic-metres-per-second discharge, suspended solids, chemical oxygen demand and dissolved fraction, conductivity and ammonium. These observations can calibrate sewer hydraulic and pollutant-load simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Berlin overflow series. Coverage is one large overflow measurement setting and observed events, not every storm or outfall in the city. Suspended solids and oxygen demand rely on local spectrometer calibration, which affects transfer; the public summary does not define missing-value treatment. Measurement periods and event-selection rules require checking in the cited reports. No CSV was downloaded or overflow volume integrated.
